comments.author: @TheEmpireSurvey
comments.text: The most fascinating part is that the Bering Strait is the only real gap between Asia and North America, and its moving sea ice makes crossing it incredibly dangerous. I also found the 21-hour time difference between the Diomede Islands amazing — you can literally walk from Wednesday into Tuesday! On a map it's possible, but the borders, visas, and extreme conditions make it almost impossible in reality.

comments.author: @SummitSurvey
comments.text: The most mind-blowing part is that you can technically walk from Asia to North America across the frozen Bering Strait, even crossing from Wednesday into Tuesday because of the International Date Line. But the real obstacles are the closed borders, impossible visa deadlines, and constantly shifting sea ice. It’s fascinating how a route that looks possible on a globe becomes almost impossible in real life.
